# City of Alamogordo, New Mexico

> > Official municipal website for the City of Alamogordo, New Mexico, providing access to city departments, public services, permits, recreation programs, and emergency alerts.

This is the primary digital portal for residents and visitors of Alamogordo, NM, offering comprehensive information on municipal services including police and fire departments, parks and recreation facilities, utility services, and community programs. The site serves as a hub for civic engagement, form submissions, and public safety communications.

## Key Topics

- Municipal Services
- Alamogordo Police Department
- Alamogordo Fire Department
- Alamogordo Recreation Center (ARC)
- Youth Sports Programs
- Building Permits & Applications
- CivicEngage Platform
- Parks & Recreation Facilities
- Wastewater & Utilities
- Code Enforcement
- Emergency Alerts
- Jim R. Griggs Sports Complex
- Infrastructure Planning
- Animal Control Services

## Municipal Services & Departments

- [Departments](https://ci.alamogordo.nm.us/149/Departments): Directory of city government departments and municipal services
- [Form Center](https://ci.alamogordo.nm.us/FormCenter): Central hub for municipal forms, permits, and applications
- [Alert Center](https://ci.alamogordo.nm.us/AlertCenter.aspx): Emergency notifications and public safety alerts from police and fire
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://ci.alamogordo.nm.us/FAQ.aspx): FAQs on building permits, animal control, and municipal services

## Public Safety

- [Fire Prevention](https://ci.alamogordo.nm.us/533/Fire-Prevention): Fire safety best practices and hazard prevention from Alamogordo FD
- [Patrol Unit](https://ci.alamogordo.nm.us/524/Patrol-Unit): Police Department patrol unit shift schedules and sergeant contacts
- [Training Unit](https://ci.alamogordo.nm.us/753/Training-Unit): Police Department training unit contact and information
- [Police Requirements](https://ci.alamogordo.nm.us/249/Requirements): Police Department recruitment and hiring qualifications

## Parks & Recreation

- [Recreational Facilities](https://ci.alamogordo.nm.us/1048/Recreational-Facilities): Parks, sports complexes, courts, and playgrounds throughout Alamogordo
- [Parks & Recreation Board](https://ci.alamogordo.nm.us/372/Parks-Recreation-Board): Advisory board for community recreation and leisure services
- [Jim R. Griggs Sports Complex](https://ci.alamogordo.nm.us/1073/Jim-R-Griggs-Sports-Complex): Baseball/softball fields and recreational facilities for community events
- [Youth Basketball](https://ci.alamogordo.nm.us/296/Youth-Basketball): Youth basketball programs at Alamogordo Recreation Center, ages 3-12
- [Youth Soccer](https://ci.alamogordo.nm.us/297/Youth-Soccer): Fall and spring youth soccer through Otero County Youth Soccer League
- [Leagues and Travel Team Required Forms](https://ci.alamogordo.nm.us/703/Leagues-and-Travel-Team-Required-Forms): Required forms for ARC sports leagues and facility reservations

## Utilities & Infrastructure

- [Wastewater Reclamation](https://ci.alamogordo.nm.us/876/Wastewater-Reclamation): Wastewater treatment using Sequencing Batch Reactor technology
- [Will-Serve Process](https://ci.alamogordo.nm.us/825/Will-Serve-Process): Water service application process and utility capacity requirements
- [Long Term Infrastructure Planning](https://ci.alamogordo.nm.us/938/Long-Term-Infrastructure-Planning): Infrastructure planning, street assessment, and pavement management

## Code Enforcement & Compliance

- [Code Enforcement FAQs](https://ci.alamogordo.nm.us/1086/Frequently-Asked-Questions): Code enforcement FAQs on property violations and municipal ordinances

## Optional

- [Holiday Schedule](https://ci.alamogordo.nm.us/870/Holiday-Schedule): Garbage collection and service schedule for holidays
- [Best of New Mexico](https://ci.alamogordo.nm.us/401/Best-of-New-Mexico): Promotional content showcasing Alamogordo's local attractions
